name: Setup Legacy
author: Zoidium
description: History-buffer ports of the OpenZoid effects: Echo (Legacy), Posterize Time (Legacy), Jpeg Damage, VHS, Datamosh, Tracery tracking callouts, and ASCII character cells, plus setup windows.

nativeEffects.name: Echo (Legacy)
nativeEffects.description: Rolling history-buffer echo with smear, maximum, additive, and screen modes.

nativeEffects.name: Posterize Time (Legacy)
nativeEffects.description: Hold-buffer frame-rate quantizer in the Posterize Time style.

nativeEffects.name: Jpeg Damage
nativeEffects.description: JPEG compression-break simulation with frequency and error controls.

nativeEffects.name: VHS
nativeEffects.description: Full VHS signal-chain rebuild: tracking, chroma crawl, snow, tears, and OSD.

nativeEffects.name: Datamosh
nativeEffects.description: Feedback motion-vector smear with algorithm presets and hold controls.

nativeEffects.name: Tracery
nativeEffects.description: Tracking callouts: boxes, markers, spline connection lines, arrows, labels, and grid.

nativeEffects.name: ASCII
nativeEffects.description: Character-cell video: resampled glyph grid with mapping, waves, noise, and scroll.
